{{Citation}}
'''Rogas''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of squat, six-legged [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creatures indigenous to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. They possessed a mouth surrounded by grasping mandibles, as well as a pair of feathery [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]] atop its head. Some [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]s theorized that the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] may have evolved from an ancient form of the roga.

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The rogas were developed for the [[2002]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones]]''. In the film's initial drafts, a group of these creatures were intended to attack [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] shortly after Kenobi landed on Geonosis.<ref name="R4-P17 DB">{{DB|droid|r4p17|R4-P17}}</ref> The design of the rogas was developed by concept artist [[Ed Natividad]] who envisioned them as crab-like creatures who would instinctively search for warm nesting places similar to real-world [[Hermit crab/Legends|hermit crabs]] with their shells. Natividad created multiple pieces concept art of the attack on R4-P17 by the group of rogas&mdash;although ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]'' identifies the astromech as [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]&mdash; who were trying to pry off the droid's head to nest in his body. One of the pieces depicted the creature as also wearing a shell like a hermit crab. A different piece of concept art of a roga was created by [[Doug Chiang]] which was more similar to an insect with [[Wikipedia:Suction cup|suction cup]] like feet. Nativad also created another design of a roga with a different insectoid body, the same suction cup legs and [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] like [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]] which was sculpted by [[Michael Murnane]].<ref name="ArtofAotC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> However, the scene was never filmed.<ref name="R4-P17 DB" />
